page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU features 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache, alongside support for instruction extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and BMI2. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. No local storage is bundled, requiring the use of remote cloud volumes, and hardware accelerators such as GPUs are not present. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate a clear divide between single-thread execution efficiency and parallel multi-core performance. Single-core tests such as stress-ng (1108.99), Geekbench single-core (967.0), and gzip compression (19.12 GB/sec) rank in the lower performance tiers, reflecting the older microarchitecture and conservative 2.5 GHz clock frequency. In contrast, parallel throughput aligns with mid-tier industry expectations. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 23056.78, a stress-ng multi-core throughput of 23516.07, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8400.0, benefiting from the full allocation of 32 dedicated threads.

Data handling and memory metrics align with its balanced general-purpose architecture. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 87.55 GB/sec, while write operations maintain 43.49 GB/sec. Operational benchmarks report solid throughput for distributed caches and multi-threaded processing, including 23.19 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks, 8441.07 on PassMark database operations, and static web serving throughput of 13.88 GB/sec. In small-to-medium scale LLM inference tests, it maintains modest execution, generating 10.25 tokens per second on a 7B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency standpoint, the ecs.sn2.7xlarge is best positioned for horizontally scalable enterprise applications that value aggregate core density and generous memory pools over single-thread peak speed. Suitable deployment profiles include backend microservices, Redis caching tiers, Clang-based software compilation pipelines, multi-threaded ETL jobs, and enterprise web application hosting.

Built on x86_64 architecture and KVM, the instance provides 128.0 GB of RAM at a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, a 6 Gbps baseline network link, and no bundled local storage or GPU accelerators. Benchmark evaluation indicates modest single-thread capabilities, evidenced by lower-tier Geekbench and compression metrics, alongside steady mid-tier multi-threaded throughput such as a PassMark CPU score of 23056.78 and 23.19 million Redis SET operations per second. The server offers viable compute density for multi-threaded workloads, including database caching, static web hosting, CI/CD compilation, and enterprise application deployments.
